reason: A bookmark and knowledge-management plugin for saving assistant replies with notes and tags, browsing them across sessions, searching and editing entries, and exporting them to Markdown.

summaries.zh: 用于收藏助手回复、添加备注和标签，并在跨会话中心中搜索管理及导出为 Markdown。
summaries.en: Bookmark assistant replies with notes and tags, manage them in a cross-session center, and export the collection as Markdown.

capabilities: stores bookmarks, notes, tags, and reply snippets
reads persisted session logs to validate bookmarked replies and derive snippets
provides cross-session search, filtering, editing, deletion, and session navigation
exports bookmarks as a Markdown file
adds browser interface actions and a keyboard shortcut
